bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 71
rooms=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts WHERE title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours'")
test "$rooms" = 0 || exit 72
drafts=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='room' AND data->>'title'='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト'")
test "$drafts" = 0 || exit 73
if "$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" room_public_post_smoke; then result=PASS; else result=FAIL; fi
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 74
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 75
echo NEW_ROOM_PUBLIC_E2E_RESULT="$result"
test "$result" = PASS || exit 76
echo NEW_ROOM_PUBLIC_E2E=PASS
